fieldNotes.site: Fort Collins CO A-B brewery (opened 1988) at 2351 Busch Dr; Budweiser brewery-tour site with Clydesdale paddock. Large rural brewery campus surrounded by farmland, with brewery, distribution warehouse, extensive trailer drop yards, and a large on-site rail yard.
fieldNotes.truckGate: CONFIRMED. z19/z20 satellite shows a dedicated truck checkpoint structure on the south access road - a building/canopy over the truck lane with a truck positioned at it. Clear controlled truck gate, separate from the landscaped visitor/Clydesdale entrance off Busch Dr.
fieldNotes.guardShack: CONFIRMED. The truck checkpoint includes a guard-booth-sized structure alongside the lane. A-B breweries operate guarded truck gates as standard.
fieldNotes.scale: A truck appears positioned on a weigh-pad-style platform at the gate checkpoint - likely a truck scale; flagged uncertain as exact pad not fully resolved.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Paved truck staging on the south access road before the checkpoint.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Extensive trailer drop yards on the SW with ~200+ trailers in long rows; capacity ~400.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks with trailers backed in on the distribution warehouse W/NW faces; estimated ~40 (band 25-50).
fieldNotes.railServed: Large on-site rail yard with curved spurs and rail cars on the SW side - heavily rail-served.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus includes the brewery, a distribution warehouse, the Clydesdale stables/visitor center, and rail facilities - multiple building clusters.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Surrounded by open farmland NE of Fort Collins - clearly Rural.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide access roads and yard aprons leave ample room to add lanes.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Boxed footprint ~267 acres for the operational campus.

citations.claim: AB newsroom confirms operation of and $15.5M infrastructure investment in the Fort Collins CO brewery (bottling-line upgrade operational summer 2024).

verification.rationale: AB newsroom investment press confirms current operation; not among the realignment closures, no negative signal found.
